blocks.text: Preparations for the 2026 Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections (BSKE) will proceed as scheduled, with the Nov. 2 polls pushing through unless Congress enacts a law postponing or changing the election date. Commission on Elections (Comelec) Chair George Erwin Garcia said the poll body needs sufficient time to deliver election materials, particularly to far-flung areas […]...
